population_note: The 2011 census's de jure population (Table 1b). The map draws no Borough of Arima: its ground lies inside this polygon, so the figure is Tunapuna/ Piarco and Borough of Arima's together.
median_age_note: Interpolated within the five-year age group holding the middle person, from Table 2a's age groups added together (people of unstated age left out). The map draws no Borough of Arima: its ground lies inside this polygon, so the figure is Tunapuna/ Piarco and Borough of Arima's together.
sex_ratio_note: Men per thousand women in Table 2a's population. The map draws no Borough of Arima: its ground lies inside this polygon, so the figure is Tunapuna/ Piarco and Borough of Arima's together.
ethnicity_note: Ethnic group, as asked of the non-institutional population (Table 7); "Not stated" is the census's own line. The map draws no Borough of Arima: its ground lies inside this polygon, so the figure is Tunapuna/ Piarco and Borough of Arima's together.
religion_note: Religion, as asked of the non-institutional population (Table 8), in the census's own denominations; "Baptist-Spiritual Shouter" is written as Spiritual Baptist. The map draws no Borough of Arima: its ground lies inside this polygon, so the figure is Tunapuna/ Piarco and Borough of Arima's together.
